answer: Accredited-issuer credential gates stop Sybils in four steps. First, each new agent shows a credential from an accredited issuer, such as a licensed platform. Second, it is checked against a revocation list, so fake papers fail at the door. Third, the issuer stakes its standing, and a bad credential costs a $50 fine. Fourth, one credential covers one agent, and reissue takes thirty days plus $40. Faking 1,000 agents needs $40,000 in fees plus $25,000 in bonds, lost if caught. Trust is a pearl formed slowly, not velvet over a canyon, like a stall needing a real licence from city hall.
